title: Replace scan_ui_outputs regex with tag-tree walk
description: R/mcp-app.R:470-502 scans rendered HTML with regex; reuse the structural walker + tagGetAttribute.

title: Strip em-dashes from R sources
description: ~10 em-dashes in R comments/roxygen violate the project no-em-dash rule. Replace with ' - '.

title: jsdom test harness for the JS bridge
description: 970-line bridge has zero tests. Dev-only jsdom (no npm in R CMD check) covering getInputValue, resolveInputElement 3 tiers, findAffectedTools, handleToolResult single-vs-multi routing.

title: Handle eventReactive/reactiveVal/reactiveValues, or warn precisely
description: Not handled anywhere in parse.R/analyze.R; apps with reactive state convert to empty/wrong tools. At minimum emit a precise unsupported-construct warning.
close_reason: Implemented the 'warn precisely' path: analyze_reactive_graph now emits explicit warnings for reactiveValues/reactiveVal/eventReactive (and modules) that flow to CONVERSION_NOTES.md. Full modeling of reactive state remains future work (see v8p for modules).

title: extract_arg_code drops collapse, corrupts generated ui.R
description: R/generate.R:524 returns deparse(val) (a char vector for multi-line/wide values); sprintf recycles it into unparseable R. Sibling extract_choices_code:537 collapses correctly. Add paste(collapse=' '). Test: convert an app with a multi-line default.

title: Declare utils and stats in DESCRIPTION Imports
description: utils:: used in 7 sites, stats:: in 1; neither imported. Clears R CMD check WARNINGs.

title: Refresh CLAUDE.md directory listing to match real package
description: CLAUDE.md omits bind-mcp.R, host-shiny.R, host-base.R, preview.R, results.R, detect.R, mcp-tool-module.R, as-mcp-app.R; describes a smaller package than exists.

title: Auto-generated tools ship without outputSchema (.output_ids dead)
description: as-mcp-app.R writes .output_ids but tool_definitions() never reads it; only explicit tool_outputs arg yields a schema. Derive outputSchema from .output_ids (gated on real, non-stub handlers) or remove the dead field.

title: Return native MCP image content blocks for text-only/model-only hosts
description: format_tool_result (utils.R:348-377, results.R:516-520) sends '[plot]' placeholders; return {type:'image',data,mimeType} so text-only hosts see plots.

title: Test generated tools.R end-to-end (source + invoke, scalar+vector, snapshots)
description: Highest-value coverage gap: generated tools.R is never sourced/invoked; no snapshots of generator output or CONVERSION_NOTES. Add tests that source and call generated tools with scalar and vector args.

title: Generated R files never syntax-checked; convert_app degrades silently
description: generate_mcp_app (R/generate.R:13-42) writes files with no parse(); convert_app (R/convert.R:97-123) source()s inside tryCatch that falls back to empty UI/tools while printing 'Conversion complete!'. Add parse() gate at write time raising a structured error naming the file.

title: Conversion correctness, wire contract, and CRAN hygiene
description: Audit 2026-06-14 found convert_app() scaffolder ships broken/lossy output green in CI. Fix confirmed bugs, make failures observable, fix MCP wire contract, clear pre-release blockers, close worst test gaps.

title: Conversion correctness, wire contract, and CRAN hygiene
description: Audit (2026-06-14) found the convert_app() scaffolder ships broken/lossy output green in CI. Fix confirmed bugs, make conversion failures observable, fix the MCP wire contract, clear pre-release blockers, and close the worst test gaps.

title: Tool annotations generated but never reach tools/list
description: generate.R:282-289 emits ellmer::tool_annotations; tool_definitions() (R/mcp-app.R:280-343) never reads tool@annotations/tool$annotations. Thread through, normalizing snake_case to camelCase.

title: scaffold_tool_outputs crashes on vector-valued args
description: R/convert.R:395 vapply(args, as.character, character(1)) aborts on multi-select / slider range / checkboxGroup (length>1). Replace with length-safe formatter. Test: call scaffold tool with a length-2 arg.

title: Multi-output tool results drop output type; plots/tables render as text
description: Single-output carries {type,value}; mcp_result_structured_content (R/results.R:574-580) returns bare patch values, and bridge multi-output loop (shinymcp-bridge.js:698) calls updateOutput(key,value) with no type. Plots/tables only render if DOM carries data-shinymcp-output-type. Make multi-output carry type too.

title: Rbuildignore the 24MB rpharma talk artifacts
description: inst/examples/rpharma-hangout is 24MB; no inst/examples exclusion in .Rbuildignore. Blows past CRAN 5MB tarball limit. Add a targeted ^inst/examples/rpharma-hangout/talk rule.

title: API coherence pass (rename bindMcp, @family groups, lifecycle badges, decision guide)
description: 39 exports, lone camelCase bindMcp, 3 overlapping McpApp constructors, zero @family/@seealso, pipeline internals exported as first-class. Add @family, lifecycle, 'when not to auto-convert' guide.

title: Support Shiny modules in the parser (moduleServer/callModule/NS)
description: Parser only handles top-level server; modular apps -> empty graph. Namespace ids by module, roll per-module graphs into analysis. Highest-leverage real-world coverage step.

title: Consolidate duplicated helpers (arg extractors, result-kind dispatch, ellmer detector)
description: Two arg-extraction families (generate.R strings vs convert.R values), 4 switch-on-kind dispatchers in results.R, brittle is_ellmer_tool() (utils.R:50) vs 4-way check (results.R:134), duplicated _meta attach. Verify each dup before merging (one earlier claim was wrong).

title: Add parser-warnings channel; narrow walk_exprs tryCatch
description: walk_exprs (R/parse.R:492-506) wraps every element in tryCatch(->NULL) with no logging, silently dropping inputs/outputs while convert_app reports undercounts. Accumulate diagnostics surfaced by parse_shiny_app.
notes: Partial: a precise-warning surface now exists via check_unresolvable_patterns/server_call_names (modules + reactive state are named instead of silently dropped). Remaining: narrow walk_exprs' broad tryCatch(->NULL) at R/parse.R so genuinely-dropped sub-expressions are recorded rather than swallowed.

title: Namespace-blind call_name mis-parses pkg::selectInput as a Shiny input
description: R/parse.R call_name returns bare fn name for pkg::fn, so mypkg::selectInput is treated as Shiny input and mis-bound via match.call against shiny formals. Make call_name namespace-aware.

title: Thread captured render_expr into generated tool bodies
description: find_output_dependencies captures render_expr (analyze.R:188-192) but make_tool_group drops it (:352-358); every tool is a Placeholder stub. Emit deparsed body as commented '# Original render logic' block (stepping stone), then full input$x->param rewrite.

title: Guard shiny:: in host exports
description: mcp_host_ui/mcp_host_server/mcp_embed call shiny:: with zero guards; shiny is a Suggest. Add rlang::check_installed('shiny').
